text: This report will update the Board of Management on the activities of the Volunteering and Engagement Unit for the year 2022. The volunteer team consists of Year-Round Volunteers, Summer Volunteers, Wildlife Health Centre Volunteers, and Zoo Ambassador Student Volunteers.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Received the report (January 25, 2023) from the the Senior Director, Strategic Communications and Guest Experience, Toronto Zoo, for information.
